text:
maria (infra): PM async — quick standup: what I did / blockers / today

maria (infra): What I did: finished spot-fallback config for us-west1, bumped reserved pool for redwood-dedicated +8 GPUs, ran a quick capacity sweep — us-west1 idle ~12 GPUs, eu-west1 idle ~3, us-central1 showing low headroom.
Blockers: us-central1 AZ quota still pending (ticket INC-4321). Cloud asked for billing contact; sent it but waiting on approv.
Today: planning a canary deploy for model-rollout-2026 at 15:30 UTC (start with 2 nodes), will monitor latency, error rate, and token spend. If cloud quota doesn't clear we need fallback routing to eu-west1 q8 variant.

josh (oncall): can you paste the exact quota request id? also what's prewarm time for the canary? :eyes:

maria (infra): quota request id GCP-QR-98765. prewarm ~6-8m for nodepool + model pull. We'll spin small canary (2 pods) then scale to 6 if healthy.

liam: saw a provisioning backlog this morning. I ran: `rwctl provisioning queue --region=eu-west1 --status=pending` -> 42 pending, ~35 are tiny experiments. Propose deprioritizing <1k tokens/min workloads to reduce churn.

anya: I can take ownership of trimming small experiments. can we add a weighted decider in autoscaler? my proposal: if q.size < 4 GPUs && avg_rps < 100 -> low priority / delayed allocation.

maria (infra): @anya yes please. also let's tag experiments created before 2026-03-01 for auto-cancel after 48h.

liam: config snippet I used for testing:
```
# deprioritize small jobs
provisioning_policy:
  min_gpu_size: 4
  deprioritize_threshold_rps: 100
```

josh (oncall): timely question — did the us-central1 quota bump come through? I pinged infra-cloud earlier.

maria (infra): not yet. @josh can you escalate to cloud-ops? updated ticket INC-4321: cloud asked for org billing contact, I sent it.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary/model-rollout-2026 -> us-west1 (2 nodes). Status: pulling images. :rocket:

anya: saw a brief token spike in us-west1 when the canary started, looks like cache miss on prefix keys. keep an eye on cache hit-rates.

maria (infra): will monitor. If latency > 150ms or error_rate > 1% we'll rollback immediately.

liam: FYI I kicked off a cache warm-up: `scripts/warm_kv.sh us-west1 3` to reduce cold-starts.

maria (infra): thanks liam. One more ask — if cloud denies quota today, emergency fallback: route model-rollout to eu-west1 using quantized variant q8. who can validate correctness on a 10% sample?

anya: I can validate. post sample prompts and I'll run A/B on 10% traffic.

josh (oncall): tagging @security for eu-west1 data residency implications.

security (bot): Noted. Will review data flow; no PII expected from canary prompts.

maria (infra): Great. I'll post follow-up after 15:45 UTC with metrics (latency p50/p95, error %, token cost delta). Thanks team. :pray: /end
